description.p: DownNux Manager is a professional, high-performance download manager designed for Linux, mirroring the speed and power of Internet Download Manager (IDM). It combines multi-connection dynamic segmentation, deep browser integration, an off-peak download scheduler, and an authentic Apple VisionOS glassmorphism interface.

ul.li: High-speed multi-threaded segmented downloads (up to 16 connections per file)
Smart video sniffer with direct resolution picker (1080p, 720p, 480p, and MP3 audio)
Off-peak queue scheduler with automatic PC sleep or shutdown upon completion
Automatic category routing (Videos, Music, Documents, Archives, Programs)
Authentic frosted glassmorphism interface with dark obsidian frost and light glass themes
Browser extension integration for Chrome, Brave, Edge, and Firefox

screenshot.caption: All Downloads view with glassmorphism dark theme

ul.li: Full IDM-grade Settings view: Appearance, multi-folder storage routing, speed limiter, connections, and desktop notifications.
Off-peak queue scheduler with automatic power actions (suspend, shutdown).
Dark obsidian theme contrast polish and frosted glassmorphism blur depth.
Multiplatform packaging support for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
